limits: Complete primary node_runs and node_attempts census from the root-verified stopped standalone Workspace database.
Expected outputs recomputed from retained admission inputs and fixture contracts without importing production transition or fixture functions.
Pinned representative graphs map execution keys to node kinds and labels; every database run revision is checked against its graph.
Sleep timestamps show persisted completion after requested delay, not full scheduling latency.
Hook tokens are deliberately omitted from retained evidence.

scopeAndLogValidation.stderrCheck: Exact expected failing-attempt count, controlled marker, byte bound and retained data digest. Stack trace formatting is not recomputed.
scopeAndLogValidation.scopeCheck: Every scope membership exactly matches all ordered node execution keys and statuses.

limits: Actual local Wrangler/Docker cohort evidence only.
All export contents, scoped node outputs, attempts, delayed approval histories and pinned revisions were verified.
Exactly 16 coordinated postcapture graph GETs were made, including one root-authorized replacement after a local field-name validation error. No node API reads.
Receipt DO/R2 and performance acceptance belong to root evidence; these semantic checks alone do not establish them.
